## Quarterly Sales Snapshot

The table groups quarters under merged regional headers, which can be lost in Markdown conversion.

| Product | North America |  | Europe |  |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Product | Q1 | Q2 | Q1 | Q2 |
| Trail Shoes | $1.2M | $1.4M | €860K | €910K |

issues.description: The table separator row is malformed: `| --- | --- | | --- | | --- | --- |` has the wrong number of cells and empty separator entries, producing an invalid/broken Markdown table.

The merged header cells are represented only by empty placeholder columns (`| North America | | Europe | |`), which does not cleanly convey the intended horizontal grouping in GitHub-Flavored Markdown.
Dollar signs in body cells are unnecessarily escaped (`\$1.2M`, `\$1.4M`), reducing fidelity to the source text.
